timeline.summary: Adani Power incorporated step-down wholly owned subsidiary Coastal-Maha Atomic Energy Limited on April 13, 2026
S.B. Adani Family Trust declared no encumbrance on Adani Power Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹14,223.09 Cr (-0.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4,017.08 Cr (+52.3% YoY).
Adani Power reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹57,865 Cr and net profit of ₹12,971 Cr with an installed capacity of 18,150 MW.
Adani Power provided the audio recording link for the Q4FY26 post-results analyst and investor call held on April 30, 2026.
Adani Power reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹15,989 Cr and net profit of ₹12,971 Cr for the full year, backed by a 13.3 GW tied-up expansion pipeline.
Adani Power informed the exchange that its response is awaited regarding a news item on CCI approval for acquiring GVK Energy.
Adani Power clarified that its resolution plan for GVK Energy under CIRP has received CCI approval but awaits CoC voting.
Adani Power incorporated Integrated Power Supply Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on May 14, 2026.

Adani Power executed definitive agreements with Jaiprakash Associates to acquire a 24% stake in JPVL, a 180 MW thermal power plant in Churk, and an 11.49% stake in Prayagraj Power Generation for a total cash consideration of ₹4,193.59 Cr.

2026-05-21: Adani Power completed acquisition of 24% shares in Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited and a 180 MW thermal power plant in Churk along with 11.49% shares in Prayagraj Power Generation Company from Jaiprakash Associates Limited.
Adani Power signs 25-year, 1600 MW thermal power supply agreement with MSEDCL
Adani Power said its 22 July 2026 board meeting will also consider raising funds via equity shares or other eligible securities, including QIP or preferential issue, subject to approvals.

Adani Power reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹18,902 Cr (+34% YoY) and PAT of ₹4,867 Cr (+47% YoY), and its board approved a QIP of up to ₹15,000 Cr and a borrowing limit increase to ₹1,00,000 Cr, with an EGM set for 14 August 2026.
Adani Power reported Q1FY27 results with 32.6% revenue growth and 47.2% PAT growth, and its board approved a QIP of up to ₹15,000 Cr.
Adani Power's Q1FY27 earnings call raised the capacity target to 45 GW from 42 GW on the same timeline; and said the ₹15,000 Cr QIP is only an enabling provision.

NCLT Ahmedabad sanctioned on 4 August 2026 the amalgamation of nine wholly owned Adani Power subsidiaries into the parent with an appointed date of 1 April 2025, while the Vidarbha Industries Power leg remains before NCLT Mumbai.
2026-08-07: Adani Power promoter group increased stake to via open market purchases and block deals
Shareholders approved increasing borrowing limits by ₹1,00,000 Cr and authorized a QIP of up to ₹15,000 Cr at the EGM held on August 14, 2026.
2026-08-18: CARE Ratings upgraded Adani Power's credit rating to AA+; Stable on ₹90,500 Cr of facilities
2026-08-20: Adani Power wins appeal at APTEL against MERC order, setting aside previous decision
2026-08-22: Investor presentation showed Q1FY27 revenue of $2,040 Mn (+20% YoY), EBITDA of $884 Mn and PAT of $514 Mn, with 18,330 MW operating and 23,720 MW locked-in capacity.
2026-08-27: Adani Power completed sale of subsidiary CIPL to AdaniConneX for ₹535.69 Cr
India Ratings upgraded Adani Power's NCDs and bank loans to IND AA+/Stable from IND AA, affirmed short-term IND A1+, and assigned ratings to additional facilities
2026-09-07: Adani Power received LOI to acquire GVK Energy's 330 MW hydroelectric power plant
Adani Power submitted its September 2026 investor presentation, highlighting strong Q1FY27 operational performance and a derisked growth pipeline.

2026-09-07: Adani Power filed its September 2026 USD investor presentation, showing Q1FY27 revenue of $2,040 Mn (+20% YoY), EBITDA of $884 Mn (+23%), 78% PLF and 23,720 MW of locked-in capacity toward a 42,050 MW FY32 target.
2026-09-08: Adani Power assigned its 2,500 MW, 25-year MSEDCL RE RTC LOA to Powerpulse Trading Solutions Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Adani Energy Solutions Limited.

2026-09-25: NCLT Mumbai sanctioned the amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary Vidarbha Industries Power Limited (600 MW Nagpur plant) into Adani Power, completing approvals from both NCLT benches; appointed date 1 April 2025, effective date pending.
Adani Power settled SEBI proceedings via a settlement order on September 28, 2026, for ₹37.05 lakh with no material financial impact.
2026-10-06: Adani Power signed Shareholders Agreement with Druk Green Power Corp. Ltd. for 770 MW Chamkharchhu-I Hydropower Project in Bhutan
2026-10-09: GQG Partners LLC disclosed reduction of 0.02% stake in Adani Power via open market sales between August 2023 and October 2026
Adani Power received a Letter of Award from Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited for 1,320 MW thermal power supply for 25 years.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹19,438.68 Cr (+44.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹6,919.45 Cr (+134.3% YoY).
Adani Power raised its FY32 capacity target to 45 GW and reported an 18.5% YoY rise in Q2 continuing EBITDA to ₹6,321 Cr.
Adani Power Limited provides link to audio recording of post results update call held on October 26, 2026.
Adani Power reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹19,951 Cr and PAT of ₹7,019.32 Cr during its earnings call on October 26, 2026.
